entry.title: Updated: dsh-unread-dot
entry.summary: macOS Dock badge and bubble chime: shows an unread badge on the Dock (dot while running, count when done) and plays a chime while the app is hidden; clears on return, built on the Badging API. Exact install spec: github:bing-bryan/dsh-unread-dot. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
